changes.before: A tidy shape the passage never carries: she is arguing with her mother at line 30.
changes.after: No line tells us she is shy. She waits eagerly at line 11, and at line 30 she answers her mother eagerly and willfully. Shy at first is the start a child expects for a girl leaving home, but the passage never gives it.
